contentHtml:
Apple Repairs Stretton

Apple computer repairs Stretton, Offers the best Apple and Mac computer repairs in Stretton and nearby areas of Brisbane!

Apple is one of the leading high-end laptop manufacturer famous for their MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, Mac Pro, and Mac mini. Having all the premium and efficient combination of hardware and software make the Apple Mac computers very expensive and deliver unparalleled performance compared to other brands of laptops. Many Apple users might find it unpractical to just buy a brand new replacement for their Macs when it starts to fail.

Computer Repairs Stretton offers a most affordable solution to restore your broken Mac and make it work like it was brand new. Why need to buy a new MacBook when our expert team are here to repair it for you? Just give us a call at 0477 319 160 and have an expert consultation with our professional technician about your Mac problems. We serve all areas of Stretton including nearby Brisbane suburbs.

Our Apple computer repairs Stretton service covers

Operating system install and update, We work on all kinds of Mac operating systems from the oldest to the newest system including macOS Sierra and OS X versions such as Yosemite, Mavericks, Mountain Lion, Lion, Snow Leopard, Leopard, Tiger, Panther, Jaguar, Puma, Cheetah and Kodiak.

MacBook RAM repair and replacement, Is your MacBook beeping 3 times? Your RAM is either insufficient to boot or is faulty. Our experts at Computer Repairs Stretton can repair or replace your RAM without any complications. We pride ourselves in offering the best Apple computer repairs and services in Brisbane!

MacBook power adapter repair and replacement, If your MacBook suddenly stops charging and does not respond to wall chargers, there might be something wrong with your power adapter. Call Computer Repairs Stretton and we will have your MacBook fixed in no time!

MacBook MagSafe board repair and replacement , In cases that your MacBook adapter is responding but refuses to power on, there could be an issue with your MagSafe board. Our expert professionals can easily identify the problems and have it fixed for you.

MacBook Logic Board repair and replacement , Are you hearing consecutive 9 beeping sound on your MacBook at startup? It might mean that your logic board needs a repair or replacement. Make no mistake, have only the professionals deal with your logic board problem, choose Computer Repairs Stretton.

MacBook battery replacement, If your battery is already at its end, not charging, not being recognized by your Mac and suddenly stopped running when plugged in, you might consider replacing your battery. Our workshop has just the perfect battery replacement for you MacBook.

MacBook Bluetooth and AirPort repair, If you noticed that your MacBook’s Bluetooth icon is grayed out and AirPort does not show up under System Profile, we can help you identify the problem and fix it right away.

MacBook fan repair and replacement, If your MacBook tends to overheat and you are hearing louder noise than normal, your laptop’s fan might need attention. Consider having it checked and repaired by professionals. At Computer repairs Stretton, we make sure that your laptop gets repaired right in the first time.

MacBook hard drive replacement, If your hard drive is damaged and you need to have it replaced, Computer Repairs Stretton will replace it for you. We can also perform data backup and restore if necessary to keep your files safe.

MacBook backlight and inverter repair or replacement, It is annoying and might also affect your productivity when your MacBook’s display backlight is not performing well.

MacBook I/O board repair and replacement, We can have your MacBook I/O board repaired and replaced if it is not working when you plugged in.

As part of our one-stop-shop computer repair services, we do not only focus on troubleshooting hardware problems, we also offer expertise in proving unparalleled software troubleshooting and updates. Call us now at 0477 319 160 with no call out fees!

Mac malware removal, It is not wise to think that your MacBook can never be infected with malware. If you suspect any signs that your MacBook is not working normally, give us a call and we will help you identify the problem and have it fixed immediately. We are fully experienced and committed on all types of virus and malware removal in Brisbane.

Mac computer system upgrades, If you need to beef up your MacBook’s memory or storage, we are here to help. Our service covers all type of hardware and software upgrades for your Mac and more.

  • Mac memory upgrade
  • Mac storage upgrade
  • Operating system update
  • Mac optimization

Internet and network setup for Mac, We can help you on your internet and network problems with your Mac. Whether it can’t connect to Wi-Fi, unable to browse the internet or having difficulties in setting up your email, give us a call and will have a repair service scheduled for you.

MacBook data backup and recovery, If you are having problems setting up your AirPort Time Capsule or having difficulties in your Time Machine configuration, Computer Repairs Stretton is here to help you. We provide the most effective back up and data recovery solution anywhere in Stretton.

Other Mac hardware repairs

  • MacBook won’t turn on
  • MacBook shuts off when you plug it in
  • Flashing question mark appears on MacBook startup
  • MacBook boots but display remains dark
  • MacBook ports and audio problems
  • MacBook screen is black but with faint graphics
  • MacBook trackpad or keyboard won’t work

Other Mac software repairs

  • MacBook data and file backup services
  • Transfer of data to your new hard drive/laptop
  • Solutions for slow working MacBook
  • MacBook driver installation
  • MacBook keeps crashing

Custom built Mac computer, Who says you can’t personalize your MacBook or any Mac computer? Why not hire our service and have your Mac custom built for you? Just give us the specifications and we will have your computer built in no time!

For all your Apple Mac computer repair needs, call Computer Repairs Stretton at 0477 319 160 and we will have it fixed. You can always visit our workshop 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays. If we think that your computer problem can be fixed remotely, our expert technician will just have you download a special software! No additional charges. You can also avail our onsite service right in your own workplace or your residence. We guarantee that our service is free from any call out fees or travel fees.
